idea-plugin.name: Barrel Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Highlights TypeScript declarations that are part of a module's public API, i.e. re-exported through a barrel (index.ts) file, so it's obvious at a glance what is internal vs. externally consumable in a modular monorepo.

No annotations or extra developer action required - the plugin resolves star exports, named exports, and aliased/type-only re-exports through nested barrel directories, and adds a clickable gutter icon that jumps straight to the re-export line.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0

  • Gutter icon on functions, const/let bindings, type aliases and interfaces that are re-exported through a barrel (index.ts/index.tsx) file.
  • Click the icon to jump to the re-export line in the barrel.
